description: Port of ESLint's `no-self-assign` rule (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-self-assign). Flags `x = x` (and &&=, ||=, ??=) for identifiers and member chains with equal tokens or, one level deep, equal objects (tokens) and static property names (props: true), and array and object destructuring as ESLint's eachSelfAssignment walks it (the i-th elements of an array pattern and an array by `compare` text `index`, holes counted, nothing after a right spread, a rest against a last spread; properties by static key after the right object's last spread), unrolled to 3 nested containers. Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.
